channel.title: Media in Belarus - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Media in Belarus (e-belarus.org)

item.title: Beltelecom will have 2mln internet services subscribers by September 2012
item.description: On June 27, 2012, Sergei Popkov Beltelecom Director General said, that national telecommunications operator Beltelecom will soon have more than 1.4 million broadband subscribers

item.title: Life:) has lost 600 thousands users for the half of a year
item.description: Belarusian cell phone services provider Life:) has lost 600 thousands users during the first half of 2012.

item.title: Belarus has blocked access to a Change.org
item.description: According to TUT.BY Belarusian authorities has blocked access to the site Change.org

item.title: MTS starts lessons of internet-literacy for Belarusian school students
item.description: MTS has started an education project “Children in the Internet”, and conducted the first part of the project – “A lesson of safe and useful Internet”.

item.title: Life:) lost 800 thousand users since the start of the year
item.description: The number of subscribers of Belarusian cell provider Life:) decreased by 800 000 in January-September 2012.

item.title: Belarusian cell phone operator incomes have grown in the 3d quarter
item.description: Each one of the three largest Belarusian cell phone operators links this to the increase of the number of Internet users and development of communications technologies.

item.title: Internet media market in Belarus keeps on growing
item.description: Annually media agency ZenithOptimedia Belarus estimates the online advertising market of the Republic of Belarus. The major Internet sales house leaders and experts were brought together on the 24th of January to analyze the results of 2012.
